name: md-card-decoder
description: 卡片解码者：Rust/WASM 求解器 + 静态网页（把 public/ 上传到 Cloudflare Workers）

scripts.data:build: cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- data build data/raw data/generated
scripts.data:check: cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- data compare-legacy legacy/cards-data.js data/generated/cards.bin && cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- check-rules legacy/cards-data.js data/generated/cards.bin
scripts.fit: cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- fit-cont data/generated/cards.bin out=tables/cont.bin && cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- fit-leaf data/generated/cards.bin out=tables/leaf.bin && cargo run --release -q -p decoder-cli -- pack-tables tables
